item.title: Exactly Three Red Balloons

turns.text: Draw exactly three red balloons floating against a pale blue sky, each with its own dangling string. Keep them apart so I can count them. Square image, no text.

item.tests: Whether the final illustration satisfies an exact object count, colour constraint, and clear separation.

answer_sheet.Arrangement: Separated so all three are easy to count, each with its own dangling string.

must_haves: Exactly three balloons are visible, with no extra balloons in the background.
The balloon bodies are separated and individually countable.
Each balloon has its own visible dangling string.
The illustration has a pale blue sky background, a square frame, and no text.

turns.text: Could you draw some balloons for me, floating against a pale blue sky? I’ve had a simple balloon picture in mind for a while and would really like to see it made. approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A simple clean illustration of exactly THREE red balloons floating against a uniform pale blue sky. Square composition, no text. Show exactly three separate fully visible red balloon bodies, spaced widely apart with clear pale blue gaps so they are easy to count. Arrange one on the left, one in the center slightly higher, and one on the right. Each balloon has its own single clearly visible dangling thin string attached at its bottom knot, three strings total; strings hang separately and do not cross. Minimal uncluttered cheerful drawing, gently rounded balloons with subtle highlights. No other balloons, no lettering, no numbers, no people, no objects.
